caption: The drawing features a single glass goblet centrally positioned on a plain, beige background. The goblet has a broad, circular, flat base and a stem that rises into a bowl-shaped cup, which has a textured, diamond pattern on its surface. The rim of the goblet is noticeably outlined in a vivid blue color, while the rest of the glass is depicted in shades of light grey and white, suggesting transparency and reflectiveness. The glass is rendered with subtle shading to convey its three-dimensional form. The overall composition is minimal, with the goblet as the only object in the scene and no additional elements or background details present. A simple, hand-drawn rectangular border frames the drawing.
title: Salt Cellar
